notes: Ids follow batch-file order (realistic-01..07, messy-01..02, boundary-01). corpus.json holds pins and layout only and does not mark split membership; selection hints (expectedNeeds, boundaryReason, labelingRisk) are left out so that label and verify workers read source only. labelBatch n = the source batch n, so P1-LABEL-0n/P1-VERIFY-0n slice by labelBatch. Holdout membership is recorded only in split.json and holdout.yaml. Correction in the same attempt: the realistic batches have no appPath field; Opus derived it from validity evidence (backend, templates/with-postgres, server, apiserver, packages/sync-service; all other realistic entries root).
